budget_source: records/o0-baseline-20261030.json (budget_seconds per row); identical values repeated in every records/artifacts-20261030/**/summary.json header. Reference = FastGS, random init, 30,000 steps, same GPU.

best_uniform.label: noreset-30kLR, 8,000 iterations, one setting for all three cases
settings: opacity_reset_interval=12001 (hw/billboard, dl3dv) and 8001 (mipnerf360/counter) -> reset never fires inside the run
position_lr_max_steps=30000 (official long schedule; NOT matched to the run length)
opacity_lr=0.025, mult=0.5, lpips_weight=0.0, res_scales=[1.0], densify_count_thresh=null, max_gaussians=null, no_densify=false, seed=20261015
best_uniform.caveat: The literal opacity_reset_interval differs per case (12001 vs 8001) only because each value had to exceed that case's total iteration count; semantically all three runs have opacity reset disabled. Rows are exact per-case settings from separate round2/round3 summary.json files; sweeps/*.json lack the lpips_weight/res_scales keys but match the remaining settings.
best_uniform.two_case_12000_note: noreset-30kLR at 12,000 iters has no counter row (counter-noreset stops at 8,000), so its 2-case mean of 54.100 is NOT a valid uniform score.

falsified.idea: More ReSplat refine rounds (num_refine 2 -> 4 -> 6) keep improving the initialization
falsified.evidence: hw quality 3.813 (r2) -> 3.874 (r4) -> 3.880 (r6): +0.067 for 4 extra rounds, and counter goes the other way 5.158 (r2) -> 4.985 (r4) -> 4.926 (r6). Recursion saturates after round 2; these are B=0 (initialization-only) rows with time_points=null.

falsified.idea: Training the default schedule longer (more iterations) is better
falsified.evidence: counter 20,000 iters has the best quality of its tag (35.538) but B=114.38 s > 92.57 s budget, so the row is INVALID (time_points 0); hw 20,000 iters totals 30.278 vs 39.931 at 1,000 iters.

falsified.idea: Using the whole budget (late snapshots) is the goal
falsified.evidence: hw total falls 41.583 (4k, 29.7 s) -> 30.278 (20k, 99.0 s = 99.5% of budget, TIME 0.118); TIME is linear in B/budget, so filling the budget is the single most expensive thing you can do.

falsified.idea: Adding VGG-LPIPS (lambda_lpips=0.2) to the B loss buys the 40-point LPIPS term
falsified.evidence: hw 4k: total 32.239 (Q 22.282) vs 41.583 (Q 26.000) for plain default and 45.173 for noreset on identical iterations; hw 8k at 108.14 s is already over budget.

falsified.idea: A coarse-to-fine resolution ramp (0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1.0) buys more optimization steps per second
falsified.evidence: hw 8k: 36.652 vs 41.574 (default) and 44.584 (noreset); counter 8k: 29.494 vs 42.396 noreset. It costs seconds without adding quality.

falsified.idea: Looser densification (densify_count_thresh=2) + a 900K Gaussian cap recovers detail the default prunes
Snapshots taken at/near an opacity reset are usable quality points
falsified.evidence: reset points collapse the render: counter 3k PSNR 10.767/SSIM 0.3580 and hw 12k PSNR 5.116/SSIM 0.1090 both score Q=0.000; 6 of 40 archived rows are such degenerate snapshots.

falsified.idea: Turning off opacity reset is a uniform win across cases
falsified.evidence: counter 8k noreset 42.396 is 0.296 BELOW the 10k baseline (42.692); the reset change only pays on dl3dv (+5.292) and hw (+1.910).

notes: 9 of 40 archived module-B rows have b_seconds_estimate > case budget (counter-lpips 8k/12k, hw-lpips 8k/12k, counter-resramp 16k/24k, hw-resramp 16k/24k, counter-default 20k); their score.valid is false and time_points is 0.0 in every case.

Only 3 of the 11 experiment tags have rows for all three cases; a uniform configuration can only be ranked within those (default-30kLR, noreset-30kLR, and the O0 baseline). hw-lpips/lpips, res-ramp, dense-900k and sweep probes are single-case.
score_summary.json (initialization-only, B=0) rows carry time_points=null, so they cannot produce a total; they are used only for the num_refine falsification.
